decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - At all times two of the four existing units shall be used only for uses within Use Class A1 of the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987, as amended, or in any provision equivalent to that Class in any statutory instrument revoking and re-enacting that Order with or without modification.

Condition : 4 - At all times two of the four existing units shall be only be used for the following uses of the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987, as amended, or in any provision equivalent to that Class in any statutory instrument revoking and re-enacting that Order with or without modification.(i) All uses within Class A1(ii) All uses within Class A2(iii) The following uses within Class D1: art gallery, medical and health services/ clinics/consulting room and non-residential education and training centres.

Condition : 5 - Prior to the commencement of any use of the units for a non-residential education or training room, details of a scheme to insulate the premises against the transmission of airborne and impact sound shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority, and the development shall be carried out in accordance with any approval given.
Condition : 6 - The uses hereby permitted shall not be open to customers outside the following times: 8:00am to 9:00pm on weekdays and Saturdays 10:00am to 9:00pm on Sundays and Bank Holidays

Condition : 7 - The use of two of the four vacant retail units for purposes within Use Classes A2 or D1 with the remaining two units being retained for uses with Use Class A1, is satisfactory, as alternative uses may add to the vitality and viability of the small shopping parade whilst the retention of two of the units for retail used would maintain sufficient opportunity for retail premises to be established. Additionally, with appropriate safeguarding conditions these uses would not be likely to adversely affect the living conditions of neighbours or traffic and parking conditions in the area. Satisfactory access for people with disabilities would be provided. Therefore the proposed development complies with the relevant London Borough of Hounslow Unitary Development Plan 2003 policies; IMP.2.1 Regeneration of Brentford Town Centre and Riverside, ENV-B.1.1 New Development, ENV-B.1.8 Access and Facilities for People With Disabilities, S.1.4 Non-Retail Uses in Locations Outside Primary and Secondary Frontages Within the Main Shopping Areas and T.1.4 Car and Cycle Parking and Servicing for Developments.
description: Use of two of the four vacant retail units for purposes within Use Classes A2 or D1 with the remaining two units being retained for uses with Use Class A1
